mapper.insert: insert into zx_questionnaire_record (visitor_uid, source_terminal, source_channel, answer_json, environment_summary, preference_summary, budget_value, submit_ip, submit_time) values (#{visitorUid}, #{sourceTerminal}, #{sourceChannel}, #{answerJson}, #{environmentSummary}, #{preferenceSummary}, #{budgetValue}, #{submitIp}, #{submitTime})
mapper.select: select questionnaire_id, visitor_uid, source_terminal, source_channel, answer_json, environment_summary, preference_summary, budget_value, submit_ip, submit_time from zx_questionnaire_record where questionnaire_id = #{questionnaireId}
